notes: SWP Teiasir is described on Mem II p. 29 (topography) and p. 245 (archaeology); same caves, tombs and cisterns, coded once for source 3. p. 29 puts caves and tombs 'on all sides' of the village: no single compass point, so position none. p. 245 says they 'undermine the village', so tombs coded as cavities. The p. 29 'curious monument' south of the village is the el Kasr tomb of p. 245. 'No spring nearer than the Farah valley' is not a pool absence statement. The p. 29 text runs on into Tubas (item 9), another village with no WBADB row within 2 km; its basin, cisterns and Neby Toba tomb ignored. Packet page '29' looks like printed p. 228 (header 229 follows). OCR on p. 245 renders el Kasr as 'c 1 K li s r'. Winepresses (S442) and rock cuttings (S419) not coded. Source 2 not accessed.
